Pagonia’s fields are infested by the mysterious »Withering«! Fertile grounds become useless, plants are dying, Rats and Wolves raid fields and villages and your infected people are too weak to work. 

Find a remedy to cure infected animals and Pagonians, keep the Withering at bay and carefully plan your strategy to defeat the witch coven. 

Discover unknown plants and boost your resistance with new buildings that expand your food production chains. Your loyal pets will guard fields and a new monumental building called »Cornucopia« will provide useful abilities in exchange for sacrificial offerings. The island's inhabitants will support you with their knowledge and goods.
